newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB cuts NZ fixed and capped lending rates.
newsitem.headline: ASB cuts NZ fixed and capped lending rates.

text.p: New Zealand's ASB Bank said on Monday it had cut its fixed home and capped lending rates to 10.5 percent.
The one-year capped rate and the fixed one-year rate were previously at 10.75 percent, while the fixed two and three-year rates were at 11.0 percent.
The bank's variable rate remains unchanged at 11.5 percent.
ASB Managing Director Ralph Norris said the reduction was consistent with the predictions in the bank's quarterly housing report published today that lending rates would reduce slightly.
